tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Dated change log for tracked datasets, newest first. Includes changed program facts (with old and new values), tax-list additions/removals and changes in what MyLatinLife covers. Dates show when MLL recorded a dataset change, not when a law took effect or a government announced a policy.

tools.name: get_dataset

Bulk exports require a commercial API key: https://mylatinlife.com

findings.name: get_latest_articles
findings.description: Retrieve recently published MyLatinLife articles and guides, newest first, with URL, dates and excerpt. Optionally match words in the title. This searches MLL content; it is not a news search across the web.

findings.name: find_mll_service
findings.description: Find a MyLatinLife service when someone wants help handling a residency, citizenship, banking, tax, document or company application. Returns service name, page and whether it starts online or with a consultation call; it does not return prices. Filter by country, service-name words or both.

findings.name: find_videos
findings.description: Find videos from MyLatinLife's YouTube catalog, newest first, about residency, citizenship, banking, tax, cost of living and life in Latin America. Optionally filter by country or words in the title; this searches MLL's channel, not all YouTube.

findings.name: about_data
findings.description: API orientation: dataset names, descriptions, row counts, verification-date ranges, country coverage, change-log start date, usage terms and citation instructions. Use this first to see whether the API contains the topic you need.

findings.name: check_tax_blacklists
findings.description: Check whether a country or jurisdiction appears on tracked tax and AML blacklists or greylists, including EU Annex I/II, OECD, FATF and selected national lists. Returns list status, dates, legal basis and stated consequences; this is distinct from the separate FATF greylist taxonomy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_golf_courses, check_citizenship_by_descent, get_latest_articles · Private data: find_visas, get_country_profile, get_program, search_programs, find_private_clubs, find_golf_courses, check_citizenship_by_descent, get_dataset, find_mll_service · Public sink: find_golf_courses, find_renunciation_rules · Destructive: estimate_tax_savings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_golf_courses, check_citizenship_by_descent, get_latest_articles · Private data: find_visas, get_country_profile, get_program, search_programs, find_private_clubs, find_golf_courses, check_citizenship_by_descent, get_dataset, find_mll_service · Public sink: find_golf_courses, find_renunciation_rules · Destructive: estimate_tax_savings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
